mentions.name: Axiomos Decide
mentions.description: This web tool is a ROI simulator for AI infrastructure decisions, comparing cloud (AWS/GCP) costs against buying on-premise GPU clusters. It takes real workload parameters such as tokens/sec, model size, and duty cycle, then models throughput and utilization to find the break-even point. The core diagnostic is free, with a paid $99 board-ready PDF report to help justify the CapEx/OpEx switch to CFOs.
mentions.problem: Teams burn cash on cloud AI compute without a clear basis for deciding when buying their own GPU clusters breaks even, and struggle with GPU cost projections for a 'cloud exit'.
mentions.audience: Teams deciding whether to keep running AI workloads on cloud providers or invest in their own GPU clusters, including CFOs evaluating the CapEx/OpEx switch
mentions.source_excerpt:
